repairs.issue: CLARABEL occasionally returned an inaccurate stage-2 representative or raised SolverError under the preregistered projection-preservation tolerance.
repairs.repair: Kept the enumerated stage-1 optimum and all original tolerances, then used active-face enumeration to select the minimum-norm simplex representative with the exact same projected response only when the CLARABEL result failed an existing postcondition or raised cvxpy.error.SolverError.
repairs.validation: The real failing design preserved the stage-1 projection to floating-point precision; solver regression tests cover duplicate representations and forced SolverError fallback. No solver call, model, split, control, or bootstrap replicate was skipped.

repairs.issue: The vector-fidelity implementation assumed every selected MMLU-Pro question had the same number of answer options, but the frozen sample contains 3-10 options per question.
repairs.repair: Zero-padded each question response to the batch maximum while requiring every model to have the same original vector length for each aligned question/dose key. Added coordinates are zero for the target and all peers and therefore add no fitting loss.
repairs.validation: Both intervention families aligned to target shape (2800, 10) and design shape (2800, 10, 7); every probability row still summed to one within floating-point precision. Regression tests cover ragged vectors and cross-model length mismatch rejection.

repairs.issue: The first completed archive was created before the completion markers were written, leaving the packaged postprocess status incomplete and omitting EXPERIMENT_COMPLETE.json.
repairs.repair: Implemented two-phase atomic packaging, excluded Python cache artifacts, and expanded the package validator to verify CRC, required outputs, complete packaged statuses, every MANIFEST SHA256, unmanifested members, unsafe paths, cache/environment directories, credential filenames and patterns, and model-weight suffixes.
repairs.validation: The original pre-repair archive was not copied to the project root. The final archive is rebuilt only after completed archive-status records exist and is subjected to strict validation before delivery.
